sloka: जीमूतयोरिवाकाशे शब्दो ज्यातलयोस्तदा।धनुर्मुक्तः स्वनोत्कृष्टः श्रूयते च रणाजिरे ।। ६.७९.२४ ।।
transliteration: jīmūtayorivākāśe śabdo jyātalayostadā।dhanurmuktaḥ svanotkṛṣṭaḥ śrūyate ca raṇājire ।। 6.79.24 ।।

translations.english: Then the sound released by the friction of the bowstring and the hand (of the two heroes) filled the sky like thunder of clouds.
